Thanks — this is close to what I had in mind for saving and managing my links, and most of it reads right: saving with a title and note, opening, editing, deleting with a confirmation, tagging and filtering, searching, sorting, and keeping everything between sessions. That covers my main purpose well.

One thing I do want changed before I sign off, because it shapes the everyday "save" moment. When I paste a link, I expect the app to go and grab the page's actual title (and ideally its little site icon) for me automatically, so I don't have to type it in myself every time. The spec instead says the title is made up from the web address when I don't type one — that's not really what I want. Pasting a link and having it name itself is a big part of what makes saving bookmarks feel effortless to me.

Could you fold in "when I save a link, fetch its real page title automatically, and let me edit it"? Everything else here is fine to move forward with once that's in.
